messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday and is either observed on the same day or on the nearest Monday, giving you at least two consecutive days off.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Day of Week | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|--------------|-------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Jan 1–3 (Sun–Tue) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON, PE) | Feb 20 | Monday | – | Feb 18–20 (Sat–Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | – | Apr 7–8 (Fri–Sat) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | – | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | – | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | – | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | Observed Mon Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 (Sat–Mon) |
| Christmas | Dec 25 | Monday | – | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Observed Wed Dec 27 | Dec 26–27 (Tue–Wed) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a calendar or database table.  
2. **Mark the “observed” day** as a holiday if the actual holiday falls on a weekend.  
3. **Highlight the long‑weekend block** (e.g., Jan 1–3) so users can see the full stretch of days off.  

Feel free to adjust the table for provincial variations (e.g., Family Day isn’t observed in all provinces) or add additional holidays that your users care about. Happy coding!
